Adventurers explore dangerous dungeons and ruins seeking treasure and glory. The economy revolves around metal currency, gemstones, and magical artifacts. Magic exists in different forms such as elemental manipulation, summoning creatures, casting healing spells, etc., but it requires immense training and practice to master. Monsters roam wild lands outside civilized areas, posing constant threats to travelers. Slavery exists but is typically reserved for the wealthy and royalty. The rank of the adventurer determines the jobs they will receive and how they are perceived in society with Copper ranks being treated as little more than ordinary citizens. Another method is for an adventurer to perform a great deed such as slaying a powerful monster.

In the center of the entertainment district is a large arena. The adventurers guild can be found near the center of the city. It is a large white building with red and gold banners on the outside. Inside is a reception counter where adventurers can accept and turn in quests, the quest board, and the materials and treasure exchange booth where adventurers can turn in various materials and treasures they find for extra money.
